relevant_nodes.statement: For every P,Q and interval I in the declared physical comparison, Persist(P,I) AND Embed(P,Q,I) implies that P remains in P_actual throughout I. Persist requires continuing constitutive support/dynamics/boundary and lineage; embedding alone neither establishes persistence nor establishes cessation.

Numerical token equality P=Q, complete-type equivalence D(P) isomorphic to D(Q), and directed causal-lineage relation P leads_to Q are distinct relations. Type equivalence need not imply token equality; lineage may branch or merge and is not an equivalence relation or a subject-count function.

For every P in P_actual in the fixed signature K, there exist an experiential K-structure Phi_K(P) and a sort-preserving isomorphism h_P:D_ontic_K(P)->Phi_K(P). This is the stipulated tokenwise structural-experiential identity axiom, including its experiential interpretation and existential commitment; it is not an empirically derived bijection or a scalar measure.
Every actual token has a nonempty distinguished experiential carrier

Given R157:COORDINATE_TRANSPORT and ANCHOR_BINDING_CONTRACT on the same instance, D|=theta_frame(r,k) iff Phi|=theta_frame(h(r),h(k)). False external anatomical membership does not logically negate the installed internal relation; this does not establish a familiar F_O interpretation.
